name: Country sporting tweed
region: Scottish Highlands and the English shires
summary: The rough wool dress of the landowner in the field. A loose tweed jacket, breeches or plus-fours, a knitted jumper and heavy boots, cut for the hill, the moor and the river.

philosophy.core_thesis: Dress for the weather, and put the sport first. A thick wool twill sheds rain, hides dirt and blends with heather, so it does the work of a coat. Age makes it better.
design_principles: Cut the jacket 5 to 8 cm full at the chest, so that the arm can lift a gun.
Pleat the back from the yoke to give 6 cm of play at the shoulder blade.
Set the knee of the breeches 10 cm below the knee joint for a plus-four, to give room for the stride.
Choose a cloth of 450 to 650 g per square metre that sheds a day of rain.
Match the check to the ground: a dark, small check for the wood, a pale, bold check for the open hill.
Add a patch pocket and a flap on each side; use leather at the elbow and cuff.
Use leather or horn buttons that hold under strain.
anti_patterns: A tight, short cut that blocks the arm
Bright, clear colours that show against the hill
Thin cloth that soaks through in the first shower
A fashion check with no link to the ground

silhouette.shape: A boxy, easy jacket with a high button stance. A belted or pleated back, over breeches that end below the knee and a long sock.
silhouette.line: A natural shoulder, a high collar that turns up against the wind, and a hem at mid-seat.
silhouette.fit: Cut loose in the body and the arm, so that the wearer can lift a gun or cast a line. Cut close at the cuff and the knee.
silhouette.proportion: Jacket length to mid-seat; breeches end 10 cm below the knee; roughly 1 to 1.4 chest to hip.
rules: Cut the jacket full across the back and give it a box pleat or an action pleat.
Raise the collar so that it closes at the neck against rain.
Gather the trouser at the knee in a buckled band, over a patterned sock.
Put a deep game pocket inside the skirt of the jacket.
Wear a tweed cap or a deerstalker with the suit, in the same cloth.

fabrics.rule: Choose a coarse woollen twill of 450 g per square metre or more, spun and dyed in the yarn. It sheds rain, wears for 30 years and blends with the heather.

methods: estate check woven in the yarn
full body canvas in the chest of the jacket
buckled knee band on the breeches
construction.closures: Three or four leather or horn buttons, a buttoned throat tab, and a buckle at the knee of the breeches.
construction.details: Patch pockets with flaps, a game pocket inside the skirt, a gun patch on the right shoulder, and a belt of the same cloth.

surface.pattern: Small checks, herringbone and plain heather mixtures; each estate holds its own district check.
surface.gloss: Tweed at 2–6 GU, dull and soft; the waxed field jacket at 6–15 GU.
surface.wear: The cloth softens and takes the shape of the wearer; the owner patches the elbow and passes the jacket to a son.

palette.strategy: Heather mixtures in brown, green and rust, picked from the moor that the wearer will cross.

processes: hand weaving at home in the Hebrides
mill weaving in the Scottish Borders
tailoring by a country tailor or a London bespoke house
fulling and finishing in running water
making.scale: Crofters weave by hand in the Outer Hebrides; mills in the Borders weave in bulk; tailors cut for the estate and the sportsman.
making.signs: A thick, flecked cloth with a rough hand, leather at the cuff and elbow, a deep game pocket, and a check that suits the ground.

pieces.form: Loose single-breasted jacket with a pleated back and a game pocket
Plus-fours that fall 10 cm below the knee in a buckled band
Waistcoat in the same check, with a flap pocket
Short field jacket with a corduroy collar and a game pocket

canonical_works.work: Fair Isle jumper worn at golf

emotion.target_response: A calm, steady sense of the open country: the wearer looks at home in wet weather and at ease with the land.

use_cases: a costume brief for a country-house drama
a heritage menswear or field-sport line
an image prompt for a country scene
a museum label on sporting dress
avoid_when: the brief wants stretch or tech fabric
the brief is a city evening look

modifiers.how: Cut the cloth finer and slim the jacket, keep the check and drop the game pocket.
Swap the tweed for gabardine and add a storm flap and a belt.

ornament_level.note: Tweed carries its pattern in the weave; a plain jacket stays near zero.
